title: Annotations in Kotlin
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of annotations in kotlin using at least one correct term from the lesson.
Interpret or adapt a small Kotlin example that demonstrates annotations in kotlin.
Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Annotations in Kotlin** as part of **Annotations, Reflection, and Code Generation**. Annotations and code-generation tools add metadata or generated code; reflection has runtime/tooling costs and Kotlin reflection/JVM APIs have their own maturity considerations. Use the subtopics—Applying Annotations, Annotation Targets, Annotation Retention—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Professional applications need repeatable tests, clear APIs, dependable dependencies, security checks, and observable failures. Apply this concept in small steps before integrating it into a larger project.
